VENUE_VS_ITEM.notes: Add item-level evidence inside broad venues; do not hard-code venue to category.

BROAD_PLATFORM.notes: Require stronger evidence or abstain for broad marketplace/platform names.

ASR_HOMOPHONE.notes: Normalize only reviewed financial homophones before model inference.

CATEGORY_BOUNDARY.notes: Clarify primary-category boundaries in generation and human audit guidance.

INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION.notes: Abstain when transaction/category evidence is insufficient.

SPECIAL_FUNDS.notes: Block transfers, refunds, reimbursements, debt movement and stored-value recharge before inference.

OOD.notes: Require deterministic transaction evidence before category inference.

NEW_MERCHANT.notes: Use held-out merchant families and lexical diversity rather than merchant memorization.
